decisions.chosen: Records with no RECORD_TYPE emit none and keep the name attribute the source states (3021, 3023: person names only). 3025, which states both kinds, is typed ORGANIZATION by the bootcamper's decision
decisions.reasoning: 3025 states NAME_ORG=PRAVENVGUPTA and NAME_FULL=WONDERLAND; the source is already Senzing-shaped, so re-labelling would invent a type the source does not give
decisions.alternative: Force PERSON on the 3 untyped records — rejected: 3025 carries an organization name
